column2: The Most Notorious Corsair Lord of the Black Ark Corsairs

Black Ark Corsairs are notorious reavers, having spent their entire lives pillaging distant lands. They are the lionised darlings of Naggarothi society, embodying as they do the drive to earn riches and glory.
The Most Notorious Pirate Lord of the seven seas

These are your scurvy seadogs. High sea reavers. Freebooters. Hard-bitten, windswept and weather-tanned. Just the right kind of people to beat seven kinds of tar out of prissy pants Imperials, weasely goblins, hoity-toity Tilean types and, well, other pirates that look at them funny.
The most renowned explorer and merchant adventurer among the Venturers, whose word sends fleets to the ends of the world.

The Venturers are the map makers, merchant adventurers, conquistadores and colonists of every seafaring people: Marienburg's merchant houses, Tilea's merchant princes, the conquistadores of Magritta, the sea-houses of Cothique and the Dawi of Barak Varr. They sail for the coasts no chart shows, sponsor expeditions into the jungles of Lustria and the Southlands, and plant colonies where most colonies die. Few come home. Those who do come home rich.

Unlocks the Sponsor an Expedition decision: put up gold, a captain and a ship for a venture across the Great Ocean. The more gold you invest, the better the odds, but most expeditions never come back.
Unlocks the Lead an Expedition decision: sail with the venture yourself. The jungle does not care who you are, and the rewards are greater for those who see it with their own eyes.
Unlocks the Native Guides decision: hire Skink trackers, castaways or half-mad survivors of older ventures to lead your next expedition past the worst of the jungle.
Unlocks the Chart a Coast decision: send a ship to map an unknown shore. Good charts make every later expedition safer and are worth gold to the right buyer.
You may press a colonial charter on coastal land across the sea with the Colonial Charter war, and found a colony in what you take.
You may raise colony buildings in your chartered holdings: Farmsteads, Fortifications, a Port, a Monument, a Venue and at last a Capitol.
Unlocks the Choose a Reputation decision: be known across the ports of the world as a Conqueror, a Merchant Prince, a Scholar or a Saviour.
Unlocks The Great Voyage decision: one last venture beyond every known chart. Few come back, and those who do are remembered forever.
Holds at least five coastal provinces with ports
